name: Mid-Ohio Sports Car Course
sources: OpenStreetMap (ODbL), USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM (public domain), USGS NAIP imagery (public domain)

notes.centre: OSM loop moved toward the NAIP midpoint, then refitted twice to the painted-road midpoint (the second time to the spline-fitted edges); uniform stations (spacing L/n)
notes.edges: one robust penalised cubic spline per side through the painted-line / kerb candidates of every capture (edges_spline.py), config features and shapes, declared straights (straights.py)
notes.profile: DEM sigma 0.7 m + lidar ground returns + clean_profile + repave fixes at the paint-step edges, re-evaluated at the fitted edges from each section's quadratic

rules.name: T4 2024 reconstruction
rules.src: midohio.com news 1084 (19 Dec 2024, Kokosing, 14 Oct - 8 Nov 2024); 2019 lidar bank 3.9-4.4 deg over s ~1950-1975 (round3.md); placement checked against the 2025 INDYCAR 360 lap (e25u_vjn1uM) and the 2026 IndyCar onboards (9Drr1VkE1_U) through T4 (round4.md)
rules.why: the 2019 survey predates the 2024 T4 rebuild that halved its banking; the measured section rotated about the kept inside (apex kerb) edge instead of an invented height
assumptions: the rebuilt 158.5 m lies symmetric about the 2019 bank peak (the operator gives the length, not the position)
the inside edge keeps its 2019 elevation (footprint and apex curbing kept: plan, not height)
the chord bank toward the inside is halved everywhere in the interval (4 to 2 deg is the ratio at the peak); an adverse slope (T5 approach, from s ~2005) is left as measured
the outside edge drops by the rotation (excavation = lowering; magnitude agrees with "up to 18 inches")
smoothstep transition over the 400 ft regraded approach; no exit taper (the measured bank toward the inside is zero by s ~2005, inside the core)
crown (the section shape about its chord) and the inside edge longitudinal profile unchanged
run-off: the outside edge change held 2 m beyond the edge and faded over 6 m back to the 2019 ground (the operator's raise has no numbers)

profile_gaps.name: T1 approach footbridge
profile_gaps.src: c20_s0160/c20_s0200; EPT3 class2+17 deck at road s230–236, 4.5m over road; clean road at s215–224 and242–251
profile_gaps.why: Deck returns mislabeled ground hide the road. Interpolate only the occluded short profile from measured adjacent road heights/slopes; no assumed height.
